recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source change is needed for FHIR-18558 unless a future work group decision changes the ValueSet resource description more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-18558 is a Published/Persuasive Vocabulary technical correction for FHIR-core ValueSet. The Jira description identifies the ungrammatical wording "A ValueSet resource instances" and proposes "A ValueSet resource instance"; the Jira summary/comment saying "instance should be be plural" is internally inconsistent with the proposed wording and the sentence grammar.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-18558 commit was found. Git pickaxe found commit 3711daf34c0bfd80da9afe8a6c468dcb2cc37d6e, "many typo fixes", changing the old active ValueSet spreadsheet source from "A ValueSet resource instances specifies" to "A ValueSet resource instance specifies" on 2018-10-10. The 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 then carried the singular wording into source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists valueset=ValueSet in the active [resources] section, so source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml is in current build scope. Current source has "A ValueSet resource instance specifies" in both the StructureDefinition description and the root ValueSet element definition. Local R4/R4B/R5 generated history also has the singular wording, and targeted Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already contains the corrected singular wording and no source edit is needed.
